final: SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost <> 0 GROUP BY rating)
